76 chapter5.indd 76 02-06-2026 10.30.36 AM Today, the India we know is a modern nation, with defined borders, defined states and a known population.
However, it was very different 500 years ago, 2,000 years ago or even 5,000 years ago.
This region of the world, which we often call the ‘Indian Subcontinent’, has had many different names and shifting boundaries.
We can learn about India’s past and evolution from many different sources.
